title: Rust no_std peer authority accepts regressed or foreign receipt clocks
description: PeerContextAuthority entries track only signer/counter/generation; issue_verified accepts arbitrary receipt_clock_domain and receipt_ticks and does not enforce a stable domain or nondecreasing ticks for a signer. FragmentationPolicy uses those ticks to create/expire T=0 hold-down tombstones, so a higher replay counter with regressed/foreign time can shorten or bypass hold-down in no_std while std Link clocks reject it. Bind authority issuance to a ReceiptClock domain/high-water and reject regression/domain substitution; add std/no_std parity tests.
notes: ReceiptEvidence tick units are receiver-defined and receive_frame() advances one logical tick per frame, yet fragmentation hardcodes FRAGMENT_TOMBSTONE_TICKS=60000 as if ticks were milliseconds. No_std authority must bind a defined time unit/clock and convert the normative 60 seconds correctly.
